description: Public catalog with explicit direction and pagination. direction=deposit is crypto-to-PIX (GET /catalog); direction=delivery is PIX/custody-to-crypto (GET /cashin/catalog). Filter by asset/network. Follow next_offset until null; an omitted route on one page is not unsupported. Delivery routes report withdrawMin, withdrawFee, minBuyAmount and entregavel when provided by the API. Use live preview for BRL cost; never hard-code minima, fees or promise an asset is deliverable merely because it is listed.
name: lunium_list_settlement_options
title: List assets and networks settling now
